title: Drifter Bar Salts Strawberry Bubblegum 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Watermelon Strawberry Bubblegum by Drifter Bar Salts blends juicy fruit flavours with a nostalgic confectionery twist. Sweet Watermelon and ripe Strawberry flavours burst onto the tastebuds, rounded off with the smooth, chewy taste of classic Bubblegum for a playful and satisfying vape. This nic salt e-liquid is crafted with a 50% PG / 50% VG blend, offering a smooth throat hit, rapid nicotine relief, and discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, especially when paired with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Drifter Bar Salts are designed to capture the punchy, mouth-watering flavours of disposable vapes in a reusable e-liquid format, helping you enjoy your favourite blends while saving money and reducing waste. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From Blueberry and Cherry to Blackcurrant Ice, to Lime Raspberry Cherry and Strawberry Raspberry Cherry, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds. Take your refillable e-cigarette or starter vape kit to the next level with this dependable, easy-to-use e-liquid.
